name: rocket_forecast
summary: Fly a copy of a rocket to a node, tick by tick, and report each leg: launch, hops, parking, re-entry and landing, fuel, power, thrust and the verdict. What-ifs for fuel, cargo and power. The game is not touched.

help.text: Destination: to, else the rocket's target, else its pad. Each engine flies by its own feed law; thrust is the game's own combustion run on a copy of what each tick draws. Lines hold gas and liquid; tanks mix with their pipe by volume every tick. Plus route, uncharted, assumptions, succeeded and verdict.
help.keys: rocket_id, rocket_name, start_state, destination {reference_id, name, code, code_value, type, ...}, route [{from, to, to_code, distance, done, charted}], uncharted, assumptions, legs [{kind, from, to, distance, outcome, detail, seconds, burn_seconds, ...}], succeeded, verdict, fuel_now_mol, least_fuel_mol, landing_limits {max_landing_mass_kg, max_fuel_plus_cargo_kg, min_fuel_mol, max_fuel_mol, survivable_thrust_drop_pct, ...}, profiles [{profile, altitude_m, outcome, fuel_used_mol, confidence, seconds, touchdown_speed_ms, survivable_thrust_drop_pct}], column {clear, from_y, to_y, blockers, more}, combustion {rate, source, note}, mining {site, kind, collectable, units_per_hour, units_in_stop, ...}.

simulation.summary: What is simulated, and what is not.
simulation.text: Physics steps and the 0.5 s game tick: gas mass, the landing autopilot, engine draws, tanks mixing, batteries paying every device's watts. Launch with gravity and the game's abort; space hops; re-entry (the confidence check once at the start, with the pad's own hop and gravity, 1 m/s2 at an Orbital Launch Mount; 0 aborts back to orbit); touchdown (soft under 2 m/s, harmless under 4, engine damage 4 to 25, faster explodes). Route: the game's pathfinder, re-planned at every node; a rocket in transit to another target turns round as the game does; a landing rocket cannot be retargeted. Not simulated, and named in assumptions: heat the tanks trade with the air, boiling or condensing in the lines (the thrust 100 K colder and warmer is given), a Pressure Fed Liquid Engine's heat exchange, a mod's engine class (engine_not_modelled), the collision trigger.

legs.summary: What each leg reports, and the limits.
legs.text: Each leg: kind (launch, hop, park, landing), from, to, distance (delta-v), outcome and detail, seconds, burn_seconds, delta_v spent, fuel start, used and left mol, first tank gas kPa at the end, mass, battery, peak and recorded thrust. A landing adds confidence and band, thrusts, start altitude and mass, lowest stop altitude, touchdown speed, last rule, power_lost, fuel_ran_out. limits (default true): landing_limits, profiles (Low 25 km, Medium 40 km, High 70 km, Max 120 km) and least_fuel_mol. column_check scans the landing column above the pad.

stops.summary: A stop at a space node: park, mine, deploy, transfer, return.
stops.text: park_s: seconds at the destination. mine: miners, collectors and holds draw power; with no cargo arguments the stop fills the slots the site's yield fills in park_s. fill_holds or add_cargo_slots (1 kg each). park_load_w. deploy_payload: at a node with Deploy (the planet's orbit) the payloads leave, 20 s. transfer_mol: fuel received (negative: given). transfer_with: another rocket whose compatible gas or liquid umbilical sockets equalise by volume, as the Transfer action does. transfer_battery_j. then_return: fly back to return_to. mining: whether this loadout collects the destination's deposit, units per hour, units and slots in the stop, and problems (also warned in assumptions and the verdict).

what_ifs.text: fuel_mol, fuel_temperature_k, fuel_mix (gas and liquid names, {"LiquidHydrazine": 1}), thrust_scale (the recorded peak the landing check uses stays), throttle, cargo_slots, add_cargo_kg, payload_kg, battery_j or battery_percent, extra_load_w, profile, min_confidence (the floor for confident_mass_kg and the verdict; default 0.25).

rocket_id.description: A rocket, its rocket network, or any part; left out when there is one rocket.

to.description: Destination node: name, map code, reference id, or 'pad'. Default the rocket's target, else its pad.

mine.description: Mine while parked: miners and collectors switched on, drawing their power. Default false.

fill_holds.description: Every cargo slot is filled by the end of the stop.

add_cargo_slots.description: Cargo slots filled during the stop.

park_load_w.description: Power draw per tick while parked; default what auto shut-off leaves on, plus mining gear with mine.

then_return.description: After the stop, fly back and land. Default false.

return_to.description: The launch mount to land on after the stop, ground or orbital; default this rocket's pad.

deploy_payload.description: At a node with Deploy, the payloads leave (their mass goes, 20 s). Default false.

transfer_mol.description: Fuel received at the stop from another rocket (negative: given), spread over the lines.

transfer_with.description: Another rocket at the stop: compatible umbilical sockets equalise with this rocket's by volume.

transfer_battery_j.description: Battery charge received at the stop through power sockets (negative: given).

fuel_mol.description: What-if: total fuel in the engines' lines.

fuel_mix.description: What-if: mole fractions by gas name (Methane, Oxygen, Hydrazine...), normalised.

thrust_scale.description: What-if: share of the measured thrust the engines give.

throttle.description: What-if: throttle for launch and hops; default the engines' own.

cargo_slots.description: What-if: filled cargo slots (1 kg each).

payload_kg.description: What-if: the payloads on the bays weigh this together (a Payload Delivery Container is 200).

extra_load_w.description: What-if: more power draw per tick all trip.

min_confidence.description: Confidence floor for confident_mass_kg and the verdict; default 0.25.

limits.description: Landing limits, profiles and least fuel. Default true.

column_check.description: Scan the landing column above the pad. Default true.
